messages:
Anika: Thanks for joining todays all-hands. Creating this follow-up thread for any remaining Qs about the headcount update, team merges, and next steps. Keep questions short and well answer live.
Maya: Quick timeline recap: voluntary transfer window opens tomorrow 9am PT, formal role changes begin in ~3 weeks. People Ops will support 1:1s and placement.
Sam: To confirm is hiring paused across the board?
Diego: Not entirely. Were pausing non-critical hires in two product orgs for 6 weeks to rebalance. Critical backfills (security, infra stability, CS SLAs) are still approved. If you have a req you believe is critical, please tag @Diego and @Maya.
Rohit: What about promotions and leveling? Any freeze there?
Anika: Promotions and leveling cycles continue. We wont freeze career progression. Budget may shift between teams; if youre mid-review, ping People Ops and your manager.
Jules: For merged teams, who makes the roadmap calls during transition?
Diego: Well assign a transition product lead and an engineering steward for each merged area for the 8-week window. Ownership matrix coming by EOD. Keep tickets scoped and flag cross-team blockers early.
Priya: On-call changes: well overlap rotations for two cycles to transfer runbook knowledge, update SLAs, and record handoff notes. If youre moving teams, expect a 2-week shadow period.
Sam: Can infra/product leads get a path to fast-review urgent reqs?
Priya: Yes  please add urgent tags and mention @Priya @Diego in the req thread. Ill host a 60m triage tomorrow 3pm to prioritize open ops hires.
Maya: People Ops transfer FAQ + form: https://go/redwood/po-transfers (includes severance, relocation, and counseling links). Confidential hotline is in the doc.
ellie-bot: All-hands recording & slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood/all-hands/1907004321 :white_check_mark:
Anika: Office hours next Wed 11-12 PST (Zoom link on calendar). If youd rather talk privately, DM Maya or People Ops. Thanks for the thoughtful questions  well post the ownership matrix and budget numbers next week.
